Deferring domain semantics to d2 does not defer this child's access foundation.

blocking_findings.description: The required inventory remains incomplete. COMPUTED is absent, leaving Evidence digest inputs and TestPlan authored-content operands undeclared. CompetingSet members declare mapping shape, kind and residual description but no conditional exact Hypothesis reference. The literal test inventory repeats that reference omission, so dictionary equality cannot establish completeness against the existing domain contract.

blocking_findings.description: prepare checks scope pins and enumerates kinds but discards collection results. It never establishes root membership relative to scope or records active/inactive rule obligations. Receipt has no inactive accounting, and both checked-inactivity sentinel instances fail. The unconditional incomplete-semantics diagnostic prevents readiness but does not fulfill the assigned applicability foundation.

blocking_findings.description: Expected obligations remain a manually executed recipe rather than a complete expansion of active declarations. The manifest supplies contracts only for paths requested by that recipe; nothing reconciles required declarations against requested paths. Fresh direct and in-memory SQLite probes added the same required text declaration to the manifest and live Evidence inventory, left the field absent and unread, and obtained empty diagnostics with successful support. Emptying lint_context.RULES also left auditing successful.

blocking_findings.description: New-validator coverage remains incomplete. The role field matrix tests only Hypothesis.confidence; role edge resolution, exact-history access and prediction-key handling lack isolated valid/negative controls. Accounting controls still lack unread-declaration and per-association substitution cases. The new multi-record controls address traversal order and missing/extra reads but do not prove the remaining wiring. Several scope rejection assertions also omit the exact subject required by the sealed oracle.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add missing/null/malformed/valid controls for the new role plumbing and isolated declaration, dependency, applicability and association guards. Assert literal subject, state, path and reason plus denied support, with deletion witnesses on direct and retained paths.
